title: Border and Contact
author: Paloma Joubert
blurb: Wendell Eriksen, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
